text:
One provider goes down and your agent stops mid task.
LiteLLM is an open source gateway that puts 100 plus LLM APIs behind one OpenAI compatible endpoint.
- Swap models by changing the model string, no client rewrite
- Fallbacks and retries when a provider rate limits or drops
- Virtual keys with budgets, rate limits, and spend tracked per key
- Self host the proxy with Docker
For builders running agents across more than one provider who are tired of patching client code.
https://www.litellm.ai
